text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...A spring blitz held at Chukyo Racecourse.
A 1200m sprint GⅠ."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And here—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —The one I look up to is running in this race.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Dignified, graceful, noble, and beautiful.
There was an Umamusume who seemed closer to PreFigh than anyone else in the world.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: I think you're still feeling lost.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Beyond that, though, is where your ideal self is waiting.
Beyond that, though, is where your ideal self is waiting.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: Go on and learn as much as you can.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Short distance isn't supposed to be your strong suit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Answer me, Kawakami-san.
Did you come here just to copy me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll take the liberty of interpreting that silence my own way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If running in this race is not something
you can take pride in, then withdraw at once.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This is a GⅠ. It is a stage where only
Umamusume who take pride in themselves are permitted to stand.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Can you take pride in who you are right now?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I'll be going on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...As a princess,
I cannot back down here."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's because... I want to learn from you...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Everyone,
the first-rate Umamusume King Halo has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Kingー!!
Did you come to claim the throne this year tooー!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it about time your era came to an end?
How long are you planning to cling to your active career~?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Those who challenge. Those who walk their own path.
They are not always met with praise.
Victory is tantamount to crushing someone else's dream."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this is my path.
Standing right here is what makes me King Halo!
